title: Distributed Multimedia Systems: Main Exam, 17 August 2021
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Using a well-labelled diagram, describe document architecture and its elements.
Elaborate on three types and uses of hypertext.
Highlight five features of drawing and painting packages.
Describe briefly effective human computer interaction in multimedia systems.
Describe why a good user interface is important to multimedia systems.
Discuss collaborative computing in multimedia systems.
Discuss the application sharing approach in multimedia systems.
Describe basic synchronization issues in multimedia systems.
Outline the five main facets of multimedia.
Outline five sources of images in multimedia.
Describe public information display systems (PIDS) in detail.
Using a well-labelled diagram, discuss the hypertext, hypermedia and multimedia relationship.
Discuss the stages of multimedia application development.
Describe the general user interface design issues.
Describe any five activities carried out in digital sound recording and editing.
Discuss the desirable features of image editing software.
Describe any five multimedia connecting devices.
